title: Exodus 34:26 — firstfruits and not boiling a young goat in its mother's milk
summary: Exodus 34:26 in English with the book name in English and Hebrew (שמות) colour-matched: bring the first of the firstfruits to the house of the LORD, and do not boil a young goat in its mother's milk.

text.text: 26 “The first of the firstfruits of your land you shall bring to the house of the LORD your God. You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.”
